mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate signals weak labor market conditions that depress consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 550 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 550.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 2.5% annualized inflation rate signals accelerating price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts below 550 thousand units and retail sales below 350 billion dollars signals a broad-based weakness in consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 550.0 and RSAFS < 350000.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in employment growth below 50 thousand persons and high unemployment rate above 9.5% signals a deteriorating labor market that depresses consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS monthly change < 50 and UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods in late-cycle expansion when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rate and rising inflation signal the Federal Reserve's commitment to combat price pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods in monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
